Reason value 'Fever and body pain since two days' wraps to a second line — no truncation/ellipsis sighted anywhere on the surface.
Booking ref 'Booking #DRHSNR' matches contract; 'Back' pill and title 'Booked' present at top.
Screen gutters look consistent at ~16px both sides; internal card padding ~16px; consistent radius across cards and buttons.
Timeline step labels (~12px 'Confirmed'/'Completed') estimated ~4.0–4.5:1 on white — borderline AA for small text.
non_blocking_notes: 'Back' pill height looks slightly under 44px (~36–40px) — verify tap target has invisible 44px hit area.
